additional_info.subject: RE: ID0441201-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / P3 170000417] Display defective CRM:02919000239
additional_info.body:
Dear Colleagues,
A site intervention should be planned to inspect the connections, as there may be a loose connection between KF1 and PH2. Please ensure that the DPP and USB connections used for the OC display and touch functionality are properly checked.
There is also a possibility that the DPP or USB cable may be faulty. We recommend swapping them with working cables to confirm the issue. During the site visit, please carry a spare HMI, DPP, and USB cables in case replacements are needed.
If all the checkpoints have been verified and the problem persists, then HMI replacement needs to be planned.
Also, check all the connection of display controller.
I am writing to formally inform that we are moving case 0441201 ﻿from the
Technical Support
